recommendation: First validation: opt-in runner-owned existing vnc-control.py observe child for a declared finite phase up to300s, fixed runner private Unix socket and no input flags. Default behavior unchanged.
Separate child/worker, never blocking Client.capture in sole QMP/control loop:15s socket waits and image encoding can delay control/deadline polling.
Record connection/first-frame and stop/error times. Claim coverage only where actual connection overlaps journey; premature exit or expiry is incomplete coverage, no automatic restart.
Observe300 is sufficient only for a≤300s planned phase, not7200s session. Repeated restarts introduce gaps and should not masquerade as continuous coverage.

If longer coverage is later required, use one bounded runner-owned drain worker, fixed endpoint, no input methods, bounded message/frame buffers, and occasional evidence PNGs rather than encoding every frame. No external persistent service.
lifecycle: Use only runner TemporaryDirectory AF_UNIX socket. Shared RFB client preserves root operator connections; None authentication stays inside private directory, no TCP listener.
Runner owns exact observer PID/start identity, polls status without blocking QMP, no autorestart.

Finish final journey capture while observer connected, then graceful stop/reap before temporary directory/QEMU cleanup. Existing finally closes socket and writes report on normal completion/exception; default SIGTERM does not guarantee finally, so future integration needs graceful stop or records interrupted evidence.
Bound join then terminate/kill only retained child if needed; observer cleanup errors must not prevent QMP quit.
resource_attribution: Current observation performs full-frame request/decode/coverage allocation/PNG encode/hash roughly once per second; not passive or zero-cost.

Record observer CPU/RSS separately from emulator PID metrics and label whole workload continuous-refresh. Guest/emulator display work changes; do not compare unlabeled no-viewer versus viewer samples.
Capture timestamps measure host request/receipt, not guest presentation.
limits: Read-only source design, no implementation/build/runtime action.
53 demonstrates refresh-dependent cadence; failed44/47 remained stale with continuous VNC. This proposal does not fix missing submissions.
Socket and capture deadlines are cooperative per-operation bounds, not a strict hard host deadline.
